finding: At the pinned rust-sdk commit, the default ClientHandler production initialization path does not opt into sampling. ClientHandler::get_info() defaults to ClientInfo::default(). The client service obtains client_info via service.get_info(), passes that ClientInfo into legacy_startup, and legacy_startup constructs the initialize request with params: client_info before sending ClientRequest::InitializeRequest. Combined only with the immediately preceding own CLEAN r252/r251 default-capability fact that sampling is None unless explicitly enabled, this exact default path serializes initialization without sampling opt-in.
scope_guard: This finding is limited to the pinned default ClientHandler -> service.get_info() -> legacy_startup InitializeRequest path. It does not establish behavior for ClientHandler implementations that override get_info(), callers that serve an explicit ClientInfo, discover-mode negotiation beyond the same carried ClientInfo, server behavior, or end-to-end scheduled-Chat parity.
